own_solution.law: The reduced mass is mu/m_e = 206.77*1836.15/(206.77+1836.15) = 185.84219. The binding energy at n=2 is B_2 = (mu/m_e)(1.44 eV nm)/(2*0.05292 nm*2^2) = 632.1163 eV. Energy conservation gives E_gamma = 150 + B_2 = 782.1163 eV and lambda = hc/E_gamma = 1.58544 nm.
assumptions: The supplied kinetic energy describes the initial relative motion of the pair.
The specified reduced-mass Coulomb Bohr model applies.
Atomic recoil is neglected as instructed.
A gap acting before the present capture adds its stated energy to the initial 150 eV.
